goatcounter-count.js is public/count.js of GoatCounter v2.7.0
(zgo.at/goatcounter/v2 v2.7.0, git tag v2.7.0, commit
7e91d8a9bdbb0dd48496e498c5680f8f3477a1b4), unchanged. It is served from
this site so that no script from another host runs on its pages. It sends
the visit counts to https://signalith.goatcounter.com/count.

SHA-256: 030ad75a7c80a04107a9b91f79e4b1572da0a583a80a9b67e111b310da11cbe9
